Resolves #20340

`PR Baseline` now cancels the run for a superseded head instead of letting it queue and then spend ten slots on that head. At 15:43Z, 3 of the 21 baseline runs queued in this repository belonged to heads that had already been superseded.

- First attempts share one group per ref, so a new head cancels the old head's run.
- A rerun gets its own group, so it never cancels the current head's run. This follows the pattern #15593 set.
- A body edit (`edited`) waits behind the running run instead of cancelling it. `same-head-check-repair.yml` reruns a cancelled run on the same head, so cancelling there would buy a full ten-job rerun.

Evidence: L2 (a spec pins the group, the cancel condition and the repair's watch list) → L3 required for AC-4 (the live queue after merge). Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: #20328.

Prescription checked: `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml` owns the concern. The caller sets the concurrency for the whole run, including the jobs it calls.

agent-preflight is not hosted here. Baseline checks ran instead: `check-ticket-archaeology`, `check-guard-ci-parity` and the pre-commit hooks.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: Non-blocking interaction to keep in view for `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#281`: in GitHub Actions, a concurrency group holds at most one `in_progress` run and one `pending` (queued) run regardless of `cancel-in-progress: false`. If an author edits a PR body while the initial `opened`/`synchronize` run is still `queued` (before any of its jobs has started), or edits the PR body twice while the first run is `in_progress`, GitHub Actions cancels the displaced `pending` run on the same SHA; when the surviving run completes green, `same-head-check-repair.yml` will rerun that cancelled first-attempt run once (`run_attempt == 2`), which safely isolates itself under `pr-baseline-${{ github.run_id }}`. Once `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#281` collapses the 10 jobs into 1 job, even that multi-edit edge case becomes a single-slot repair. Also verified against `node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-workflow-concurrency.mjs` (`lines 86-114`): because `cancel-in-progress` is an expression rather than the literal string `'true'`, `isInScope()` skips grading this block, making `PrBaselineConcurrency.spec.mjs` the load-bearing guard for the `github.run_attempt == '1'` clause here.
